item: The rollup serve answers live when the engine runs out of memory, not an empty list
summary: windowed_top_terms_raw and windowed_term_counts returned [] / {} on every engine error, so a plain OutOfMemoryException inside the served query left an empty most-mentioned or trending answer (queries.top_terms and trending go live only on None). The engine's out-of-memory error now returns None so the caller goes live (R194); an ordinary error keeps the empty answer; the fallback counter still counts both by error class. Red without: 4 of 5 new tests fail on the old code, including queries.top_terms end to end. Corrects the #1467 entry, which said the serve fell back to the live scan.
